title.narrative: Enhance affected and underserved communities resilience to harsh condition in Dar'a and Deir-ez-Zor ( sub-objective 2)

description.narrative: ltpgtTwelve year-long crisis followed by devastating multiple earthquakes that hit parts of Syria in February 2023 has exacerbated the severity of existing humanitarian needs in Syria. Long years of conflict have raised the population’s vulnerability to the impact of this disaster with many people having lost their jobs and businesses. , humanitarian actors are transitioning to a longer-term response to address the needs of affected populations and help them rebuild their lives and livelihoodsltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtExecution of the project activities will improve the public infrastructure damaged, livelihoods and support the resilience of extremely vulnerable peoplelt/pgtltpgtThe target areas are Dael, Izra in rural Dara"a and Khasham, Tabni in rural Deir-ez-Zorlt/pgtltpgtThe target sectors of this program are as following:lt/pgtltpgtltbgt1- Early recovery and livelihoodslt/bgtlt/pgtltpgtAccording to the 2023 Syria Humanitarian Needs Overview, livelihood support represents the third highest unmet need (46 per cent) of the population in Syria after food (60 per cent) and electricity (52 per cent). The dire economic situation and high inflation have weekended the population’s coping mechanisms, deteriorated access to livelihoods, ability to meet basic needs and the availability and affordability of services. These have resulted in high unemployment rates and risks related to resilience and social cohesion of communities.lt/pgtltpgtThe activities under this sector will be:lt/pgtltpgtltbgt- Vocational Training:lt/bgt Activity main goal is to provide affected families in target areas with vocational training courses to enable them to have an honorable source of income to help their families and other society war affected members taking into consideration protection main streaming and gender equality, through conducting vocational training sessions.lt/pgtltpgtltbgt- Micro grants business:lt/bgt Skilled project participants will receive life skills and business training conducted by external trainers as well as tools and equipment in different types of projects agriculture, industry or services, to help them to start their own project.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtIn this sector 150 H.H will benefit from VT activity and 30 H.H from Grants.lt/pgtltpgtltbgt2- Food Security and Agriculturelt/bgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtMassive depletion of livelihoods infrastructure, high levels of unemployment and poverty coupled with high food prices and inflation have all contributed to low purchasing power, as households struggle to meet their daily food needs. The project will contribute to food insecurity through:ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltbgt- Rehabilitation of irrigation canals: lt/bgtthis project will be implemented in Tabni and Khasham area in the countryside of Deir ez-Zor.lt/pgtltpgtThis activity in this proposal will contribute to achieve the Zero Hunger WFP main goal through the following objectives:ltbrgt-Support light and major rehabilitation of relevant economic/productive infrastructure through appropriate modalities.ltbrgtThis project will be a continuation to a project currently GOPA implementing in coordination with WFP, which is the supply and installation of water pumping stations from the Euphrates River to agricultural lands in the targeted areas.ltbrgtThe total agricultural land that will served from this project is 300 Hectares, and 4,000 H.H will benefit from improving the agricultural productivity.lt/pgtltpgtltbgt- Rehabilitation of bakeries: lt/bgtthisltbgt activitylt/bgt will target rehabilitation of one bakery in Dael/Rural Dara'a to secure the basic needs of high quality daily bread to 5,000 H.H.lt/pgtltpgtThe works will include renovating the bakery building, supplying and installing a new production line, and supplying an electric generating. lt/pgtltpgtltbgt3- Protectionlt/bgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtGBV risksltbgt:lt/bgt Women and girls in Syria already faced ever-increasing risks of GBV and reduced opportunities to live in a place they consider safe.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtActivities:lt/pgtltpgt- Awareness GBV session. lt/pgtltpgt- Provision of unstructured PSS activities to 1500 beneficiaries with the objective to respond to different needs of specific vulnerable groups.lt/pgtltpgt- Provision of both structured and PSS activities to 500 beneficiaries with the objective to respond to different needs of specific vulnerable groupsltbrgtlt/pgt
